notes: REF-BM-02: metadata extract collects only title+description (extract.ts); no favicon or preview image captured/stored. REF-BM-04: edit dialog covers url/title/description/tags but there is no note field anywhere (schema/DB lack it). REF-BM-07: card shows title/description/tags but no real favicon (only a first-letter placeholder site-mark; favicon never collected). REF-BM-10: tag inputs are plain comma-separated text fields with no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. REF-BM-12: search covers title/url/description/tags but no note (no note field); note listed in placeholder only. REF-BM-14: '#tag' is treated as literal substring, no tag-search syntax. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised groups, only substring includes. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact match. REF-BM-17/18/19: no read-later/unread lifecycle; app implements a separate 'favorite' flag/filter, which is a different concept, not read/unread state. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions (BookmarkActions.tsx is an empty stub; routes are single-item only). REF-BM-23: no markdown note feature. REF-BM-24/25: no local snapshot, PDF handling, or Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: no persisted user display settings (default sort, displayed items, font size); sort/limit are ephemeral UI state only.
